From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@medlia.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Chris O'Neill <chris.oneill@aws-partners.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Partner sync — Medlia / Redwood co-sell enablement

Hi Laura + Chris,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Medlia is excited about the latency/cost profile you showed. We have a commercial opportunity with a payer prospect that could be a good fit for an AWS co-sell motion. Before we go further we wanted to get you looped into the enrollment process and align on next steps for PDM/PSM introductions and a short mutual action plan.

As a start: can you confirm the details you need from us to complete the AWS co-sell enrollment (ACE)? I attached a short RFI that covers compliance and deployment questions. We also have some preferred dates for a 30-minute kickoff next week.

Quick context:
- Account: Medlia Health (payer analytics)
- Estimated ARR footprint for initial pilot: $120k ARR
- Primary AWS contact: Chris O'Neill (cc)

What we'd like from Redwood:
1) Confirmation on ACE enrollment steps and any documents we should fill out
2) Intro to the PDM and PSM folks who will coordinate the co-sell motion
3) A two-week action plan that outlines tech/deal owners and first milestones

Attached: medlia_AWS_RFI.pdf (short answers)
Proposed times: Tue 11/24 10:00–10:30 PT, Tue 11/24 14:00–14:30 PT, Thu 11/26 11:00–11:30 PT

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan

Samira — really appreciate the note and the RFI. Glad the demo landed well. Happy to run the ACE path and introduce our customer-facing leads.

High level next steps from our side:
- I'll start the ACE enrollment paperwork with AWS and share the enrollment checklist (you may get an AWS email to confirm).
- Looping in Karthik (sales ops) who will coordinate the MAP and HubSpot deal setup.
- I will introduce Mina (our PDM) and Naomi (our PSM) in the next message — they'll own technical qualification and deployment readiness.
- Proposed kickoff: Tue 11/24 10:00 PT — works on our calendar. I booked a tentative 30-min slot (link below).

Please review the attached mutual action plan draft; it's intentionally lightweight — we can iterate after the kickoff. I attached a MAP template (Medlia_Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Attachments referenced: Medlia_Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (version 0.1), medlia_AWS_RFI.pdf
Scheduler: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/laura/30min

If that schedule works, we'll use the kickoff to: identify technical owners, finalize ACE enrollment contacts, and map decision timelines.

Best,
Laura Bennett
